description: This file defines a Sphinx extension for rendering a manifest projects revision table, including a class for the directive and a setup function.

classes.name: ManifestProjectsTable
classes.description: A Sphinx directive class that generates a table of project revisions from a manifest file.

methods.name: rev_url
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given revision, assuming GitHub URL format.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Builds and returns a table node listing projects and their revisions based on filter options.
